checks.test: const track = $('.marquee__track'); const rules = []; const walk = (list) => { for (const r of list) { if (r.media && r.conditionText && /prefers-reduced-motion\s*:\s*reduce/.test(r.conditionText)) rules.push(...r.cssRules); else if (r.cssRules) walk(r.cssRules); } }; for (const s of document.styleSheets) walk(s.cssRules); return rules.some((r) => r.selectorText && track.matches(r.selectorText) && (r.style.animationName === 'none' || /(^|\s)none(\s|$)/.test(r.style.animation) || r.style.animationPlayState === 'paused' || /^0(s|ms)?$/.test(r.style.animationDuration) || r.style.animationIterationCount === '1'));

const btn = $$('button').find((b) => /pause|stop/i.test(b.textContent + ' ' + (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''))); if (!btn) return false; const track = $('.marquee__track'); if (getComputedStyle(track).animationPlayState === 'paused') return false; await click(btn); const cs = getComputedStyle(track); return cs.animationPlayState === 'paused' || cs.animationName === 'none';
const doc = document.documentElement; const cards = $('.cards'); return doc.scrollWidth <= doc.clientWidth && cards.scrollWidth <= cards.clientWidth + 1;
const bs = $$('.stepper button'); return bs.length === 2 && bs.every((b) => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= 24 && r.height >= 24; });
